# Navigation

The destinations of a product: a list or bar where the current one is marked.

- Status: implemented
- Category: navigation
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “landmarks”; HTML `<nav> with links, aria-current=page`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **item**: Link with an optional icon.
- **indicator**: Marks the current destination.

## Variants

- `bar`: Horizontal (header) or bottom bar (mobile).
- `rail`: Vertical, desktop apps.
- `dock`: The site's touch dock: written tiles .

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `current`: An indicator and aria-current; not colour alone.

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Through the destinations. |

## Accessibility

- Role: navigation
- Name: aria-label when a page has more than one navigation.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (A)
- 2.4.3 Focus Order (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA)

## Platforms

| Platform | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| web | nav.nd-navigation with native links |
| ios | TabView / NavigationSplitView sidebar |
| android | NavigationBar / NavigationRail |
| flutter | NavigationBar / NavigationRail |

Web: `.nd-navigation` in kit.css; modifiers `.rail`, `.dock`.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <nav class="nd-navigation" aria-label="Example bar">
    <ul role="list">
      <li>
        <a href="#component-navigation" aria-current="page">Overview</a>
      </li>
      <li><a href="#component-list">Library</a></li>
      <li><a href="#component-menu">Settings</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <nav class="nd-navigation nd-navigation--rail" aria-label="Example rail">
    <ul role="list">
      <li>
        <a href="#component-navigation" aria-current="page">Overview</a>
      </li>
      <li><a href="#component-list">Library</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <nav class="nd-navigation nd-navigation--dock" aria-label="Example dock">
    <ul role="list">
      <li>
        <a href="#component-navigation" aria-current="page"
          ><span aria-hidden="true">◇</span>Overview</a
        >
      </li>
      <li>
        <a href="#component-list"><span aria-hidden="true">▤</span>Library</a>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
</div>
```
